f.title: Obtain NREB permission and LMHRA authorisation before starting a clinical trial
f.statement: Before starting a clinical trial in Liberia, the applicant (sponsor, sponsor legal representative, principal investigator or sponsor-investigator) must obtain written permission from the National Research and Ethics Board and authorisation from the LMHRA under the CT Regulation 2019.
f.clause: 2.2 Application for a Clinical Trial Authorisation from the LMHRA, 2.2.1
f.legal_basis: LMHRA Act 2010 Part V s 5(1); CT Regulation 2019

rows.quote: Before commencing a CT in Liberia, the applicant (Sponsor or Sponsor's legal representative or Prinicipal investigator or Sponsor-Investigator) Principal Investigator (PI) must obtain a written permission from the National Research and Ethics Board (NREB) and autorisation from the LMHRA in accordance with the requirements laid down in the CT Regulation 2019.
rows.location: 2.2 Application for a Clinical Trial Authorisation from the LMHRA, 2.2.1

f.title: Include DSMB composition, terms of reference and member CVs in the CTA dossier
f.statement: The clinical trial application dossier shall contain information on the composition of the Data and Safety Monitoring Board, including the member list, terms of reference and curricula vitae justifying their expertise.

f.title: Submit the investigator's brochure with safety data and SmPCs for registered medicines used
f.statement: The CTA dossier shall contain the investigator's brochure with relevant chemical, pharmaceutical, pre-clinical and, where applicable, clinical safety and efficacy data about the IMP, and the product information (SmPC, leaflet, labelling) if the IMP is registered. Protocol and IB content and format should follow ICH GCP.

f.title: Treat amendments affecting participant safety as substantial; check IB updates for substantial changes
f.statement: Amendments are substantial where they are likely to have a significant impact on the safety or physical or mental integrity of participants or on the scientific value of the trial. The annual IB update is not per se a substantial amendment, but the sponsor has to verify whether it involves substantial changes, in which case the substantial amendment rules apply.

rows.quote: Amendments to a CT are regarded as ‘substantial’ where they are likely to have a significant impact on the safety or physical or mental integrity of the CT participants, and/or the scientific value of the trial. Annual update of IB is not per se a substantial amendment. However, the sponsor has to verify whether the update relates to changes which are to be considered as substantial. In that case, the rules for notification of substantial amendments apply to the change.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, level and statement.

f.title: Get LMHRA and NREB approval of substantial amendments before implementing them
f.statement: Any substantial amendment to the protocol, trial arrangements, IMP or related product shall be approved by the LMHRA and the NREB before it is carried out. The signed cover letter shall state possible consequences for participants already included and for the evaluation of results; NREB written approval is needed before the LMHRA decides.

f.title: Assess progress reports and safety data for changes needing a substantial amendment
f.statement: Progress reports including safety data and annual IB updates are not per se amendments and need not be notified as substantial amendments, but the sponsor has to verify whether the data require changes to the authorised documentation; if the change is substantial, the substantial amendment rules apply.

rows.quote: Progress reports including safety data as well as annual updates of investigator’s brochure are not per se an amendment and thus do not have to be notified as a substantial amendment to the LMHRA. However, the sponsor has to verify whether the data presented requires a change to the documentation submitted with the request for authorization of a CT.

f.title: Report IMP-related SAEs/SADRs on the LMHRA SADR form
f.statement: The PI or sponsor shall report serious adverse events and serious adverse drug reactions suspected to be related to the IMP, with the timelines for related investigations, as stipulated in the CT Regulation 2019, using the LMHRA Suspected SADR Report form (Annex 3).
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.1

rows.quote: The PI/ Sponsor shall report serious adverse events (SAE)/ serious adverse drug reactions (SADR) suspected to be related to the IMP and indicate the timelines allocated for related investigations as stipulated in the CT Regulation 2019 state location in the regulation by using a Suspected SADR Report form provided by the LMHRA (Annex 3), available from the LMHRA website:

f.title: Report IMP-related SAEs/SADRs occurring in Liberia within 3 calendar days
f.statement: The PI or sponsor should report any SAE or SADR suspected to be related to the IMP that occurred in Liberia immediately, and in any event no later than 3 calendar days after becoming aware of the event.
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.2

f.title: Multicentre trials: submit IMP-related SAEs/SADRs from sites outside Liberia within 15 calendar days
f.statement: In multicentre trials with sites outside Liberia, the sponsor or PI shall submit to the LMHRA all SAEs/SADRs deemed related to the IMP within 15 calendar days.
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.3
f.applicability: Multicentre trials with sites outside Liberia

rows.quote: In case of multi center trials involving CT sites outside of Liberia, the Sponsor/PI shall submit all SAEs/ SADRs deemed to be related to the IMP within 15 calendar days to the LMHRA.

f.title: Submit at least annual progress reports with safety updates and DSMB reports
f.statement: The applicant shall provide a progress report on the trial at least annually (unless the CT certificate says otherwise) on the LMHRA template (Annex 4), containing recruitment status, safety updates, DSMB reports and, if applicable, an update on biological samples exported from Liberia.
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.4

rows.quote: The applicant shall provide a progress report on the CT to LMHRA by using the Progress Report template (Annex 4) at least annually, unless otherwise stipulated in the CT certificate. The report should contain recruitment status, safety updates and DSMB reports as well as update on the use and results collected on biological samples exported out of Liberia (if applicable).
rows.location: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.4
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, level and statement.

f.title: Inform LMHRA of trial suspension or premature termination within 10 working days with reasons
f.statement: The applicant shall inform the LMHRA of suspension or premature termination of a trial within 10 working days, giving clear reasons for the decision.
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.5

rows.quote: The applicant shall inform the LMHRA of CT suspension or premature termination of a CT within 10 working days and provide the reasons clearly explaining such decision.
rows.location: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.5
rows.review_note: Review: no deadline_rule: no clock-start wording in the source. Double-check: agree.

f.title: Notify LMHRA within 30 calendar days of the end of the trial
f.statement: The applicant shall notify the LMHRA within 30 calendar days from the end of the trial; the definition of end of trial should be documented in the protocol.
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.6

rows.deadline: Within 30 calendar days from the end of the trial

f.title: Submit a closeout report with disposal certificate within 90 days of trial completion
f.statement: The applicant shall submit a closeout report with the disposal certificate to the LMHRA within 90 days from completion of the trial, using the Annex 5 template.
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.7

f.title: Submit an ICH E3 end-of-study report with all adverse events within 1 year
f.statement: The applicant shall submit a comprehensive end-of-study report conforming to ICH E3 within one year from the end of the trial; the report shall contain any adverse events reported by PIs.
f.clause: 6. Adverse events and clinical trial reports, 6.8

f.title: Keep a Trial Master File (sponsor) and Investigator Site File (PI) available to LMHRA
f.statement: The PI shall keep an Investigator Site File and the sponsor a Trial Master File containing the essential documents that allow verification of trial conduct and data quality; the files shall be readily available and directly accessible to the LMHRA on request.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

f.title: Archive TMF and ISF, including participant medical files, for at least 25 years
f.statement: The sponsor and the investigator shall archive the contents of the TMF and ISF respectively, including participants' medical files, for at least 25 years after the end of the trial.
